text: 【瑞银颜湄之：将2026年中国银行业收入增速预测上调至7–8%】瑞银亚洲金融机构行业研究主管颜湄之在中国银行业报告中表示，2026年上半年，中国无抵押消费信贷首次出现收缩，信用卡贷款和线上贷款是主要拖累，而银行消费贷款有所增长。瑞银预计2026年整体无抵押消费信贷将收缩，2027年持平，自2028年起每年小幅增长1%。她表示，中资银行的拨备重点正从房地产转向消费信贷，对中国银行业的压力测试表明，出现额外拨备可能性较低，因此，预计银行的每股股息将保持韧性，甚至可能上升。
text_en: [UBS Yan Meizhi: Raises 2026 China banking sector revenue growth forecast to 7–8%] Yan Meizhi, head of Asian financial institutions research at UBS, said in a report on China's banking sector that in the first half of 2026, China's unsecured consumer credit contracted for the first time, with credit card loans and online loans the main drags, while bank consumer loans grew. UBS expects overall unsecured consumer credit to contract in 2026, stay flat in 2027, and grow modestly by 1% annually from 2028. She said Chinese banks' provisioning focus is shifting from real estate to consumer credit, and stress tests on China's banking sector indicate a low probability of additional provisions; therefore, banks' dividends per share are expected to remain resilient or even rise.
